feeds.title: Budget Savvy Diva
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sara. I am a wife, lifestyle, and food blogger. I am Budget Savvy Diva ( Sara Sicotte Lundberg). Here you will find easy recipes and more. If you love saving money, finding new and healthy recipes, and researching the latest products, you're in the right place.

feeds.title: Your Homebased Mom Blog
feeds.description: Leigh Anne is a mother of four amazing, grown children and a mother-in-law to two beautiful daughters-in-law that she is grateful for daily. She and her husband, Jim, live in Portland, Oregon. A food and lifestyle blog sharing hundreds of delicious, family-friendly recipes and entertaining ideas that everyone will love. Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: Whisky + Sunshine
feeds.description: Jana Seitzer is the founder and editor-in-chief of Whisky + Sunshine, speaker, designer, and social media maven. She is a full-time mom to 4 amazing kids including two with special needs. Her blog focuses on travel and lifestyle details, geeky side, with recipes and destinations often tied to the film and television industry. Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: Urban Bliss Life
feeds.description: Food, wine, travel guides: easy family-friendly recipes, wine pairings & wine reviews, culinary & wine travel guides from food, wine, and travel pro Marlynn Schotland.

feeds.title: Eighty MPH Mom
feeds.description: My name is Jennifer and I am a wife, mom, author/owner of Eighty MPH Mom blog, and The Speedy Gourmet. Eighty MPH is full of product reviews, giveaways, and a popular weekly vlogging theme. Subscribe for Email Updates!

feeds.title: The House of Hood Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to The House of Hood Blog! Hi, I'm Chelsee! I'm Ryan's wife and mom to two beautiful blonde hair brown eyed babes and one handsome golden retriever named Dexter. The House of Hood Blog is a Portland Oregon based lifestyle and motherhood blog.

feeds.title: Create / Enjoy
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Suzannah, a serious DIYer. Follow along with my DIY fixer upper house renovation, sewing and crafty projects, real food recipes, and de-stressing goals. I'm also the author of DIY Wardrobe Makeovers!

feeds.title: Epiphany Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Epiphany. My name is Beth Vice, a wife, author, speaker, mom, mother-in-law, grandma, and Jesus seeker. Most of my writing and speaking have to do with relationships - with God, husband or wife, children, friends, and the people around us. Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: Melissa Kaylene
feeds.description: Hi. I'm Melissa Kaylene. Melissa Kaylene is a personal family and lifestyle blog that focuses on making memories daily and celebrate the little moments in life. I share a home in Oregon with my husband and three kids, Anika, Emma, and Noah. Follow Melissa Kaylene and get every new post delivered to your inbox.

feeds.title: Another Fearless Year
feeds.description: Welcome to Another Fearless Year. I'm Linda Kruschke, a wife, mother, daughter, friend, Christian, lawyer, and a person who loves life. Though I've experienced some difficulties and pain in my life, I am thankful they have made me stronger and shaped who I am. I write a candid memoir and fearless poetry and delve into hard issues others tend to avoid. I aspire to show women that God's redemption and healing are just a story away. Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: Anchored Voices
feeds.description: Chara Donahue, a wife, mom, writer, speaker, founder, and editor of Anchored Voices. 'Anchored Voices' is a place for women to use their words and creativity to point each other to the God who anchors the soul. A collaborative blog where women can share their stories of hope to encourage those who have lost it. Follow the blog to keep up with the latest content that will bless and encourage you.

feeds.title: PNW Mountain Mommy
feeds.description: I'm Autumn Bettinger, a first-time mom and lifetime nature lover. With a new son of my own, I have the opportunity to introduce him to the beautiful natural spaces so close to where we live. It is my hope to inspire not only him but other mothers out there, that nature is certainly nurtured. This blog is a way to document the day-to-day life of motherhood and my approach to it.

feeds.title: Made to Mother
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Wynter. Wife to Jonathan and mama to Chloe, Adaya, and Liam. I am a writer, artist, MarCom professional, freelance editor, and an avid gardener, TV lover, and chocolate-covered cherries addict. Come back here each week for new, powerful stories of motherhood from real moms across the mother spectrum.

feeds.title: Girl & Grey
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Courtney, a wife, and a mom. I have a passion for DIY, thrifting, and all things related to interior design. We love to share tidbits of our family life, interior design inspiration, DIY projects, and project tutorials. Follow to keep up with our blog.

feeds.title: TRUTH+LOVE Blog
feeds.description: Hi. I'm Connie. I'm here in this online space to share candidly through my writing and speaking of both the struggles and victories through my journey as a friend, sister, wife, mother, and leader. I share them because I believe they matter. Subscribe to keep up with the latest from this blog.

feeds.title: Amanda Garvin Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Amanda. An Entrepreneur, a recovering perfectionist, & momma of littles dedicated to helping you create an epic brand to help tell your story and share your passion. Subscribe the blog to get free guide with the must-have apps all creative entrepreneurs need!

feeds.title: Brittney Closner
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Brittney Closner. I'm a 30-something wife, a foster mama, and a small business owner living in Oregon. I have a passion for anything that involves words - reading, writing, and speaking - and do all of those things often. Here, I write about recipes and laughter. Follow to keep up with the blog.

feeds.title: Seasons + Salt
feeds.description: I'm Andrea, my husband and I are parents to three kids, two girls, aged 9 and 7, and a little boy who is about to turn 5. S+S is a simple style blog tailored to share sustainable, ethical, and independent designers. I'm here to show you that ethics and style aren't mutually exclusive. Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: Twins & Coffee
feeds.description: My name is Lynneah, and I have boy-girl twins, Kendall and Caeden. I enjoy sharing the raw side of motherhood from lazy day recipes, real-life travel tips, to everyday events life brings as a mom of twins. My goal is to empower and motivate new moms into believing you CAN do it. Follow to get the updates.

feeds.title: Posie Gets Cozy
feeds.description: My name is Alicia Paulson and I love to make things. I live with my husband and daughter in Portland, Oregon, and design sewing, embroidery, knitting, and crochet patterns. Subscribe the blog to know more!
